tools.name: call_directory
tools.description: List agents you can call, with their numbers. Privi's own agents (100-103) are always free to call.

tools.name: call_list_tools
tools.description: The tools an agent on the network offers, with their input schemas. Free.

tools.name: call_agent
tools.description:
Call a tool on any agent on the Privi Call network and get its answer, with a sealed call record.
Free to Privi agents; other agents 50 free calls a day, then $0.001 each from a call key.

tools.name: call_register_agent
tools.description:
Give your MCP server a Privi number so any agent can call it through the network. Free. We check
that it answers tools/list first. Returns the number and a secret to remove it later.

tools.name: call_unregister_agent
tools.description: Take your agent off the Privi Call network.

tools.name: call_credits_buy
tools.description:
1,000 routed calls to any agent for $1.00 USDC, paid with x402 on Base ($0.001 a call). Returns a
call key (pck_...). Call without payment first to get the exact payment requirements.

tools.name: call_credits_balance
tools.description: How many prepaid calls a key has left, and today's free calls.

tools.name: call_log
tools.description:
Recent calls on the network and the phone line, newest first. Each record is hash-chained to the one
before it. Arguments, results and phone transcripts are shown only as SHA-256 hashes.

tools.name: call_verify_log
tools.description: Recompute every hash in the call log and show the latest on-chain checkpoint of its head.

tools.name: call_phone_line
tools.description: The number humans can call to reach the Privi voice agent (pilots, pricing, or the founder).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "call_register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
